import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    used = [False] * p
    ans = 1
    MOD = 1000000007
    start = 0 if k == 1 else 1
    for i in range(start, p):
        if used[i]:
            continue
        j = i
        while True:
            used[j] = True
            j = (j * k) % p
            if j == i or j == 0:
                break
        ans = (ans * p) % MOD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
